title: Carrot Cocktail: We Own That Door
ldName: Carrot Cocktail: We Own That Door
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine the vodka, carrot juice, lime juice and ginger liqueur in a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Rinse a rocks glass with absinthe, then discard remaining spirit. Place one large ice cube in the glass, then strain contents of mixing glass into the glass. Garnish.

Turmeric-Cinnamon VodkaCombine 10 oz. of vodka with 1 cinnamon stick and 1 Tbsp. of ground turmeric in a jar or bottle. Let sit for 3 days in a cool environment. Strain the ingredients out of the jar before using.
